biotools.summary: DeepTaxa is a hybrid CNN-BERT deep learning framework for multi-rank taxonomic classification of 16S rRNA gene sequences. It predicts all seven Linnaean ranks from domain to species in a single forward pass and provides pre-trained checkpoints for full-length 16S and V3-V4 amplicons.
